review_method: Fresh independent visual inspection of all eight assigned original PNGs using view_image, plus read-only inspection of the batch input, four case metadata JSON files, the relevant design handoff constraints, and the static Paperwhite browse prototype declarations.
identity_method: Candidate and reference SHA-256 values were recomputed from the original PNG file bytes using Get-FileHash. The candidate byte hash is the pixel identity used by this review.

comparison_scale.coordinate_basis: All comparison coordinates and dimensions below are approximate logical 1x pixels; reference physical coordinates were divided by two.

limitations: This review covers only the four assigned reference pairs and does not establish that the entire round is clean.

Only existing assigned PNGs, JSON metadata, and the relevant static handoff/prototype declarations were read. No application, build, tests, validation suite, smoke test, runtime probe, Git operation, or product-code modification was performed.
Geometry coordinates are visual estimates normalized to logical 1x scale; no derived image, crop, or additional screenshot was loaded.

PNG byte hashes were independently recomputed. Binary and source identities were matched against the supplied run values in all four case metadata files; the executable, source bundle, and reference bundle were not independently rehashed.

The QR payload, endpoint connectivity, install/update actions, language filtering, and add/remove persistence were not exercised. Endpoint availability is supported here by the existing capture capability declaration and visible waiting state, not independent network verification.
